title: The Spiral of Pre-Decision

features.name: the first cottage
features.desc-on-touch: A small grey-board house with a door that opens in both directions simultaneously. Inside, two meals are cooling. The choices have already been made; you are learning to recognize which one you took.

features.name: the spiral marker
features.desc-on-touch: A white line turning inward toward a point that never arrives. The spiral grows smaller the deeper you follow it, yet somehow each loop contains the entire architecture of the decision.

features.name: the stack of rooms
features.desc-on-touch: Each layer holds a different version of the same room. You can see through all of them at once: in one, you are choosing left; in another, right. Neither has happened yet, but you remember both futures.

features.name: the threshold that branches
features.desc-on-touch: A doorway that splits the air into probabilities. Every possibility is equally real until you stop looking. The moment you choose the threshold, you forget all the other futures as if they never existed—or always did.

inscription: you are standing in all the moments you have not yet chosen; they are choosing you
